20260914175129.json.Full API spec: include/QRMatrix.h: class QRMatrix final { public: static constexpr std::size_t SIZE = 21; static constexpr std::size_t FINDER_SIZE = 5; QRMatrix(); bool get(std::size_t row, std::size_t col) const; void set(std::size_t row, std::size_t col, bool value); static bool isFinderCell(std::size_t row, std::size_t col); static bool expectedFinderValue(std::size_t row, std::size_t col); private: std::array<std::array<bool, SIZE>, SIZE> modules_{}; }; Semantics: value type storing a 21x21 module grid initialized to false, then three exact 5x5 finder markers at origins (0,0), (0,16), (16,0). Each finder has border=true, inner ring=false, and local center(2,2)=true; there are no separators and no fourth marker. get/set enforce bounds and throw std::out_of_range for any index outside [0,20]. isFinderCell returns true for exactly the 75 cells belonging to those three 5x5 markers; expectedFinderValue returns the required boolean for finder cells and is meaningful only when isFinderCell(row,col) is true. include/QRCodec.h: class QRCodec final { public: static QRMatrix encode(const std::string& text); static std::string decode(const QRMatrix& matrix); static bool detect(const QRMatrix& matrix) noexcept; }; Semantics: Data positions are every non-finder cell in row-major order scanning rows 0..20 and columns 0..20 and skipping cells where QRMatrix::isFinderCell is true; there are exactly 366 positions. Wire format bits: first 8 bits are unsigned length N (0..255), then N payload bytes encoded MSB-first, then a checksum byte equal to sum(payload bytes) % 256, followed by zero bits to fill the 366 positions. encode(text): rejects text.size()>40 with std::invalid_argument; maps wire bits into the non-finder positions row-major; writes finders as per QRMatrix constructor and leaves them untouched; zero-fills remaining capacity after checksum. decode(matrix): first validates every finder cell against QRMatrix::expectedFinderValue and throws std::runtime_error on any mismatch; reads non-finder bits row-major; parses length N from first 8 bits; throws std::runtime_error if N>40 or if the capacity (366 bits) cannot contain N bytes plus checksum; reconstructs exactly N bytes MSB-first; verifies that the subsequent checksum byte matches sum(payload)%256; requires that all remaining data bits are zero and throws std::runtime_error on any non-zero padding; returns the exact byte string payload on success. detect(matrix) noexcept: returns true only if decode(matrix) succeeds (catching all exceptions) and false otherwise. include/QRRenderer.h: class QRRenderer final { public: static std::string render(const QRMatrix& matrix, const std::string& on="##", const std::string& off="  "); }; Semantics: rejects empty on/off markers with std::invalid_argument; returns a string consisting of exactly 21 lines (one per row) concatenated with exactly 20 newline characters and no trailing newline; each module renders to the provided markers with no I/O. src/Main.cpp: encodes literal "CodeWM", decodes it, prints at most one concise line (for example, indicating success or the rendered matrix if desired within constraints), and returns 0; no input, no loops, deterministic.
